# Gymo Issues / Gymo Issue 指南

Welcome to contribute to Gymo! Please search existing issues before submitting a new one to avoid duplicates.

欢迎为 Gymo 提交 Issue！在提交前请先搜索已有 Issue，避免重复。

## Issue Types / Issue 分类

| Type / 类型 | Label / 标签 | Template / 模板 |
|------|-------|----------|
| Feature Request / 功能请求 | `enhancement` | [Feature Request Template / 功能请求模板](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) |
| Bug Report / Bug 报告 | `bug` | [Bug Report Template / Bug 报告模板](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) |

## Current Roadmap / 当前需求规划

Gymo's future requirements are planned in [REQUIREMENTS.md](../REQUIREMENTS.md), prioritized as:

Gymo 的后续需求已规划在 [REQUIREMENTS.md](../REQUIREMENTS.md) 中，按优先级分为：

- **P0**: Exercise Library Management / 动作库管理 → `feature/exercise-manager`
- **P1**: Workout Statistics / 训练数据统计 → `feature/workout-stats`
- **P1**: Data Backup & Export / 数据备份与导出 → `feature/data-backup`
- **P2**: UI Polish / UI 美化 → `feature/ui-polish`
- **P2**: Set Drag-to-Reorder / 组次拖拽排序 → `feature/set-reorder`

When submitting a feature request, please note the corresponding branch if one exists.

提交功能请求时，如已有对应分支请在 Issue 中注明。

## Before Submitting / 提交 Issue 前检查

- [ ] Searched existing issues, confirmed no duplicates / 已搜索现有 Issue，确认无重复
- [ ] Used the appropriate template / 已使用对应模板填写
- [ ] Bug report includes reproduction steps and environment info / Bug 报告已包含复现步骤与环境信息
- [ ] Feature request includes motivation and acceptance criteria / 功能请求已说明动机与验收标准
